verdicts.note: Direction holds but the evidence is thin. S1 (voter statement) says only "fight for affordability" and says nothing about taxes. In S3 the only candidate-specific tax-or-fee statement is keeping grocery bag fees low. 'Each candidate is focused on affordability and lowering taxes' is the reporter's line about all four primary candidates, not her own statement. Her criticism of the gas tax is already counted on the climate axis. No platform plank, income-tax position or I-645 position. Low confidence.

Only generic slogans: 'defend public safety' [S1] and website headings 'Stand with Law Enforcement' / 'Keep 4th District Neighborhoods Safe' [S2]. She gives no position on enforcement versus prevention, so the direction is inferred. This matches the King LD1 P1 precedent (Wang safety adjusted to -1 low for generic law-enforcement support).
